upstream.description: Desktop app that records your on-screen work session and uses the GitHub Copilot CLI to reconstruct it as an intent + ordered steps, then builds a reusable Skill or Automation for Microsoft Scout, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, or Copilot Studio.

classification.analysis: Skill Recorder is a Microsoft Electron desktop app (macOS primary, Windows supported) that records a user's on-screen work session — clicks, window/app switches, browser URLs, clipboard, and optional spoken narration — then uses the GitHub Copilot CLI to reconstruct the session into a clear intent plus ordered steps. From that reconstruction it generates a reusable `SKILL.md` Skill or a scheduled Automation for Microsoft Scout, Copilot Cowork, or Copilot Studio, preferring native agent tools (like `gh` CLI or web_fetch) over UI-click replay so a single recorded example generalizes to similar tasks. Aimed at non-technical and technical users who want to teach an AI agent a repeatable procedure by demonstrating it once, with local-only capture and explicit warnings about not recording secrets since Analyze sends data to GitHub's cloud.

use_cases.title: Record a manual workflow once and turn it into a reusable agent Skill
Generate a scheduled Automation from a demonstrated task
Teach an agent to fill out forms by demonstrating one example
